subject: Autumn Renewal QBR — demo orchestration, legal readiness, and standby plan
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@orionhealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orionhealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — availability and procurement timeline

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last month. We want to lock in the renewal QBR + product roadmap demo in early December. A couple of asks from my side before we book: 

- Can Redwood provide a short preflight checklist (security & data handling) for our legal/procurement team to review?
- We need an attendee matrix (who from Redwood will present which topic).
- Preferred demo length: 45 minutes + 15 minutes for procurement/legal clarifications.

Proposed windows (ET):
- Tue 1 Dec — 10:00am–11:00am
- Wed 2 Dec — 2:00pm–3:00pm
- Thu 3 Dec — 11:30am–12:30pm

If those don't work, please propose alternatives for the same week. Procurement is looped for SLA/term questions — they may request a DocuSign link after the session.

Appreciate a confirmation by next Tuesday (24 Nov) so we can align internal calendars.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Product, Orion Health
[Attachment: legacy-contract-summary.xlsx (xls, 12KB)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@orionhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, procurement@orionhealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — availability and procurement timeline

Alex — thanks for the windows and the context. We can absolutely support the preflight checklist and a compact runbook for the session. Quick plan below: 

1) Proposed slot: Wed 2 Dec, 2:00pm–3:00pm ET — we’ll run a 45m demo + 15m legal/term Q&A.
2) Presenters: 
   - Ben Carter (renewal overview & value recap)
   - Marissa Cole (technical roadmap & demo)
   - Monica Patel (CS/ops: post-decision onboarding and runbook)
3) Preflight: attaching a short checklist for your procurement/legal to review. It covers data isolation, retention, and audit logs.
4) Deliverables before the call: attendee matrix, slide deck, and a short video clip of the new autoscaling demo (if you want a quick preview).

If procurement needs DocuSign immediately after, flag that and Monica will surface the paperwork cadence (SLA addendum vs standard TOS).

I'll hold the Wed 2 Dec slot tentatively and will convert to confirmed once you reply.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Renewal_Preflight_Checklist.pdf (pdf, 48KB); Attachment: QBR-Agenda-v2.docx (docx, 9KB)]

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@orionhealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orionhealth.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:11:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — availability and procurement timeline

Ben — Wed 2 Dec 2pm ET works for us. Procurement had a quick pass on the checklist; two items they want addressed during the call:

- Confirmation of audit log retention for Dedicated deployments (how long, export format).
- Outline of access controls + SSO/SCIM timing for onboarding.

They also asked if you can share a lightweight run-of-show so our legal team can join only for the last 15 minutes (they prefer not to sit through the entire demo). Can you note the exact minute markers for the demo segments?

We'll treat this as a renewal + minor expansion conversation (adding dedicated pool capacity in Q1). Please include any cost-estimate slides for dedicated capacity so procurement has context.

Thanks — Alex

Ben / team — putting the final run-of-show below so we can paste into the calendar invite and into the Drive folder. Alex — Monica and I will follow the minute markers so legal can drop in at the right time. 

Run-of-show (Wed 2 Dec, 2:00–3:00pm ET):
- 2:00–2:05 — Quick intros and renewal objective (Ben)
- 2:05–2:20 — Value recap & usage highlights (Ben)
- 2:20–2:40 — Roadmap demo (Marissa) — demo will include autoscaling scenario and private deployment checklist
- 2:40–2:50 — Operational onboarding & access control walkthrough (Monica)
- 2:50–3:00 — Legal/procurement Q&A (open)

Notes / prep items:
- Monica: please prepare a one-slide cost snapshot for the dedicated pool (Q1 expansion) — high/medium/low sizing with ballpark unit economics.
- Ben: I'll upload the demo recording snippet and the Drive link to the calendar invite.
- Alex / procurement: if you want the legal boilerplate ahead of time, we can push the SLA redlines doc to shared drive (I will mark which clauses are exceptions for Dedicated).

Attaching a final checklist and the agenda. Once Ben confirms, I'll send the calendar invite with the Drive links and a DocuSign placeholder (if procurement requests it post-call).

—Marissa
